aboutText: Lee Electrix has been providing high-quality electrical work to Spotswood and the surrounding areas since 2004. We are a local, licensed team dedicated to safety, reliability, and excellent customer service. Whether you need a simple repair, a full home automation setup, or electrical work for a new build, our experienced team has you covered with over 20 years of local expertise.
servicesText: Lee Electrix offers a comprehensive range of electrical services for homes and businesses across Spotswood. Our licensed team handles everything from routine maintenance to complex installations with precision and care, ensuring all work meets the highest Australian safety standards.
